notes: ~480Hz with R-OUT-PROT. Film not X7R: DC bias coefficient moves the corner 30% at 10V. ON THE JACK SIDE of R-OUT-PROT, never the op-amp side - inside the loop it is a capacitive load and the stage can oscillate.

description: Panel breath GAIN - attenuator ahead of the summer
notes: Attenuator, NOT a feedback rheostat - a rheostat makes gain and offset share a resistor and the knobs fight, which is the coupling the REF trimmer removes one stage upstream. 0.125 to 1.000 against a fixed x4 = 0.5 to 4.0 at the jack. *** WIPER MUST BE BUFFERED: *** it drives R-IN, so an unbuffered wiper makes the gain depend on a source impedance that varies with rotation. Taper is a feel question and therefore a bench question, TBD at E10. THIS ROW OWNS THE RV09 ORDER-CODE TRAPS for all three pots; POT-OFFSET and POT-RESP cite it. FOUR THINGS THE ORDER CODE HAS TO CARRY [Taiwan Alpha RV09 series, datasheets/connectors/RV09AF-40.pdf]: (1) THE PLAIN -40 HAS NO BUSHING AT ALL - it is snap-in and the panel needs only shaft clearance; a bushing is a SUFFIX, E1 = metal M9x0.75 or E1N = plastic D9, and either takes the panel hole to ~9.5mm. (2) CENTRE DETENT IS SUFFIX 0C and it costs half the life - 5000 rotations with the click against 10000 without. (3) *** THE A/B LETTER IN RV09A / RV09B IS THE ROTATIONAL ANGLE *** (280 +/-5 deg vs 300 +/-5 deg), NOT THE TAPER; the taper is a separate A/B/C code, and this is a standing trap. (4) Body 9.8mm wide, 11.4mm across the snap-in lugs, 7.0mm board-to-shaft for every -40, shaft D6.0 0/-0.1 - three across 50.50mm is 34.2mm, so the pot body is nowhere near binding and the 14mm knob is the constraint. THE PART MAY NOT BE ALPHA: Thonk ships the Song Huei R0904N, dimensionally interchangeable (datasheets/connectors/R0904N.pdf)

description: Panel breath OFFSET - bipolar, zero at centre
notes: *** THE WIPER IS UNBUFFERED AND ITS TRUE ZERO IS NOT AT CENTRE: it sits at +0.605V, about 20 degrees past, and the number that matters for a detent is that one. *** The often-quoted 'centre = +0.07V' omits the wiper's own R/4 = 2.5k source impedance and is wrong; panel.md derives +0.605V and this row agrees with panel.md. Endpoints are unaffected - source impedance is 0 at both ends - so CCW +5.04V and CW -4.89V stand, and it is only the middle that moves. CONSEQUENCE FOR THE PART CHOICE: a centre-detent variant would click 20 degrees away from actual zero, which is worse than no detent, so DO NOT order one unless U-RESP is fitted to buffer this wiper - see that row, which spends both of the module's remaining spare op-amp halves to do it. E10 decides whether that is worth a package. RV09 order-code traps are on POT-GAIN and are not repeated here

description: Sets the 0.5x floor of POT-GAIN's attenuator
notes: 7.15k under a 50k track gives 7.15/57.15 = 0.125, so the gain bottoms at 0.5x rather than zero. Without it the knob reaches a mute nobody asked for and an easy way to think the instrument is dead
